overview: The primary mix totals 436: 149 offices and 287 apartments, comprising 172 studios, 62 one-bedroom, 48 two-bedroom and five three-bedroom homes.
research.locationNote: Dubai Land Residence Complex, Dubailand, Dubai.
research.priceNote: Original summary: studio AED 650,000. Property Finder’s narrative instead gives AED 1,865,150, with a rounded AED 1.9m launch headline. Different inventory/bases; current quotation required.
research.handoverNote: Developer forecasts Q2 2028; original summary says June. Property Finder specifies 30 October 2028. Headline withheld pending confirmation.
research.paymentNote: Historical 60/40 calendar transcribed by Mitchell’s shown. Developer also describes 70/30: 70% by completion, then 30% quarterly over three years. Portal instead labels 30% at handover. Confirm the contract.
